gaps.sentence: The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.hint: noun: the state of being free from rule
gaps.explanation: 'Gain independence' = become self-governing; the noun form follows the verb.
'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.
